hints: When the bag is sealed, nothing can get out. So where does the gas go? And does the scale change?

Air feels like nothing. But it's made of tiny bits, and each bit weighs a little. The fizzing turns some of the baking soda and vinegar into gas. A sealed bag keeps every bit inside, so the weight stays the same. The gas needs more room, which is why the bag puffs up.
Seal the bag and run it again. Watch the bag puff up, and keep an eye on the scale.
